title: rosbe variables
description: Configuration variables for the ReactOS Build Environment (rosbe) toolchain component

ROSBE_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for rosbe ('libscript_native' provisions isolated RosBE directory, 'system' uses host MinGW-w64 + CMake + Ninja).

ROSBE_VERSION.description: Specific release version of ReactOS Build Environment to provision.

ROSBE_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading the prebuilt RosBE-Unix or RosBE-Windows archive.

ROSBE_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying available upstream RosBE release versions.

LIBSCRIPT_ROSBE_VERSION.description: Override version of RosBE used during ReactOS source compilation.

LIBSCRIPT_ROSBE_ARCH.description: Active ReactOS target architecture exposed by RosBE ('i386' for 32-bit i686 or 'amd64' for 64-bit x86_64).

LIBSCRIPT_ROSBE_URL.description: Custom mirror URL for fetching the RosBE cross-compiler bundle.

LIBSCRIPT_ROSBE_INSTALL_DIR.description: Custom destination directory for isolated RosBE toolchain installation.
